  • Method Details

    • mode

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder mode(@NonNull FaceSearchMode value)

    • group

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder group(@Nullable java.lang.String value)
      Exact group match. Null or an empty string means unrestricted. Changing scope prepares the corresponding cache again.

    • tag

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder tag(@Nullable java.lang.String value)
      Exact tag match, combined with group using AND. Null or an empty string means unrestricted.

    • needLiveness

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder needLiveness(boolean value)
      Single-frame liveness. Enabled by default for single-face mode and disabled for multi-face mode. Explicit enabling is allowed only in single-face mode.

    • infraredLiveness

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder infraredLiveness(@NonNull InfraredSearchConfig value)
      Select single-face search with IR liveness, disabling default RGB liveness automatically. Explicit needLiveness(true) or MULTI_FACE conflicts with this setting and is rejected by build(), regardless of Builder call order.

    • threshold

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder threshold(float value)
      Identity-similarity threshold, 0.75..0.85; default 0.80. Invalid values immediately throw IllegalArgumentException.

    • searchIntervalMillis

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder searchIntervalMillis(int value)
      Delay after a successful search, 0..3000 milliseconds; default 0. It is not the camera frame interval.

    • searchTimeoutMillis

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder searchTimeoutMillis(int value)
      Time budget per search round, starting when a face is first selected. Range 1000..3000 milliseconds; default 3000.

    • maxFacesPerFrame

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig.Builder maxFacesPerFrame(int value)
      Multi-face mode processes at most 1..5 faces per frame; default 3. Single-face mode processes only the largest face.

    • build

      @NonNull public FaceSearchSessionConfig build()
      Validate the final mode/liveness combination without restricting setter call order.
